adjudication.rationale: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb, the migration reads the old `embeddable_hosts` setting, does `val.split("\n")`, and then inserts each entry with raw SQL: `VALUES ('#{h}', ...)` (no trimming/normalization). This bypasses the `EmbeddableHost` model’s `before_validation` normalization (stripping `http(s)://` and paths) and its `validates_format_of :host` regex. As a result, entries containing `\r` from CRLF, surrounding whitespace, `http://` prefixes, or trailing paths will be persisted verbatim and will not match `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host`/`host_allowed?`, which queries `where("lower(host) = ?", uri.host)`, causing allowed hosts to fail exact-match lookups.
